summary: T1 item 8: sim/CHARACTERIZATION.md is the one aggregated, current, per-spec-row rollup for this block, and it names the sim/<slug>/records/ evidence record behind every verdict. It is generated (sim/build_characterization_report.py), never hand-edited, and CI regenerates and diffs it on every push, so it cannot drift from the committed evidence. Item 8 asks for the aggregation artifact to exist and be current, not for every row to pass: this report currently reads FAIL on PSRR, MIXED on Startup, and marks most rows' underlying sim record STALE against the current design/netlist/*.spice. Those are item 5's gap, tracked there as unmet, not item 8's. Current limit and Thermal read PASS as of issue #139's re-run against DR-0005's ratified 62-95 mA / <= 346 mW rows (they read FAIL while the head record was still graded against the superseded 65-80 mA / <= 290 mW ones). Stability reads PASS against the DR-0018-ratified envelope (issue #276), with the wider DR-0001 full-matrix result shown alongside rather than driving the verdict. See signoff/README.md for the full reading. PSRR reads FAIL as of issue #289's re-run: sim/psrr-vs-freq and sim/psrr-vs-freq-50ma both fail the ratified > 50 dB @ 1 kHz row at 3 of 45 corners (worst 29.4268 dB at ff_125c_3.63v), superseding a stale PASS pair taken 2026-09-05. Root cause and why no sizing lever closes it: spec/decision-records/DR-0031. That is a real design gap, surfaced by the rollup rather than hidden by it -- which is the property item 8 grades; the gap itself is tracked as issue #302.
